title: Emerald to Ruby Continued
description: Added more languages of the ruby from the original Emerald to Ruby.
body:
Literally taken from the original emerald to ruby and made it compatible with the version 1.21.11 and 26.1.x. Do not give bug reports to the original Emerald to Ruby.

Language compatibilities:
English (en_us)
Korean (ko_kr) Added
Chinese (zh_ch) Added

(1.21.11 and 26.1.x won't be updated.)
